set.body:
Outcome
Make the final completion decision from reproducible evidence.

Owned scope
docs/evidence/final-acceptance; support/readiness documentation

Prerequisites
D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A reviewer distinct from implementation owners reviews the exact candidate and samples independent reruns of native, consumer, scientific-isolation and lifecycle evidence.
- [ ] Every acceptance row in PLAN.md is mapped to a passing receipt or an explicitly non-blocking declared limitation; no required missing platform/run or open major defect is hidden.
- [ ] Reconcile artifact hashes, provider/application pins, local results and any hosted results; distinguish generated/configured checks from executed checks.
- [ ] Readme/support claims match evidence; publication, signing/release credentials and deployment remain outside this acceptance action.
- [ ] Close this gate only on a recorded accepted verdict; otherwise record the exact failing obligation and return it to its owning task.

Required evidence
SHA-bound independent verdict and evidence coverage map; this gate unblocks E3 closure, then the delivery umbrella.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code D7. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [D7] Independently review the complete v0.1 acceptance evidence
